2.5.5

Change how existing values are arranged and distinguish joining an axis from adding one.

Reshape or transpose

reshape keeps the element count fixed and can infer one axis set to -1. T transposes a 2D array. A reshape can return a view or a copy depending on the memory layout.

import numpy as np

a = np.arange(1, 7).reshape(2, -1)
print(a.tolist())
print(a.T.shape)
Example output
[[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6]]
(3, 2)

Concatenate or stack

concatenate joins arrays along an existing axis. stack adds a new axis. For stack, all input arrays must have the same shape.

import numpy as np

a, b = np.array([1, 2]), np.array([3, 4])
print(np.concatenate([a, b]).shape)
print(np.stack([a, b]).shape)
Example output
(4,)
(2, 2)
